subject: general
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

Uluru is the world's largest monolith and Australia's recognisable natural icon with an elliptical shape and a circumfarence of around 94 kilometers.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Circumfarence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Circumfarence"** is incorrectly spelled in the sentence. The correct spelling is **"Circumference"**. (परिधि)

 
 
• **Example:** The circumference of the Earth is about 40,075 kilometers.
 
 
 
• **"Circumference"** refers to the distance around a circular or rounded object. (परिधि)
 
 
• **Example:** We measured the circumference of the tree trunk for our science project.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Circumfarence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Elliptical** (अंडाकार): Shaped like an ellipse, an elongated circle.

 
 
• **Example:** The planet's orbit is elliptical, not perfectly circular.
 
 
 
• **Monolith** (एकाश्म): A large single upright block of stone, especially one shaped into or serving as a pillar or monument.
 
 
• **Example:** The ancient monoliths still stand tall after thousands of years.
 
 
 
• **Kilometers** (किलोमीटर): A metric unit of measurement equal to 1,000 meters.
 
 
• **Example:** The marathon race covers a distance of 42 kilometers.
